description:
Cast Time Warp by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal, choosing to pay its replicate cost once, by paying a total of {U}{U}{U}{U}, targeting Time Warp.
Narset's Reversal's replicate ability triggers, creating a copy of it targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of the original Narset's Reversal targeting Time Warp and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the second copy of Narset's Reversal, creating a copy of Time Warp and returning the original Time Warp to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Time Warp, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
